verdict.rationale: Notte documents hybrid scripting that lets you script the deterministic parts and use AI only where needed. Those scripts and generated workflow code can be deployed as serverless Functions/API endpoints that are invoked and scheduled, which gives repeatable multi-step workflows rather than one-shot prompts. Loops, conditionals and parameterization are never explicitly documented; they are only implied by the workflows being editable code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of loop/conditional constructs, documented workflow input parameters, and independent hands-on corroboration of composed multi-step workflows.
